We've got one maintenance bay available and three vehicles on the draft board — M-12, V-8, and G-3 — all listed for routine service with no special sequencing or parts action recorded. Before I sign off, I need to hear from each of your sections on any changes or issues. Let's start with the maintenance chief, then the dispatcher, then the supply NCO. Who's reporting first?
